answer: Attackers who spin up many identities face a rising tide of capital costs, and any attempt to fake history triggers a spiral of slashing penalties that outweigh the gains from forging identities. Sybil resistance can be built through a staked reputation ledger where each agent must lock collateral before voting, and reputation decays on a fixed sonnet-like rhythm of periodic checkpoints. In practice, Agent0215 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
